card: Removes dead code—including unused methods, constants, type aliases, and template instantiations—across kernel, GUI, script, netbase, and test code. It also enables `-Wunused-macros` and `-Wunused-template` compiler warnings. This serves as preparatory cleanup to enable the broader `-Wunused` compiler flag in Bitcoin Core (#36167).
evidence: Author notes the PR is "Part of #36167" (RFC to enable -Wunused across the codebase).
problem: Unreferenced code and dead helpers clutter headers and internal interfaces after their callers are refactored or deleted. Their presence prevents the build from enabling broader `-Wunused` warning flags without triggering build errors.

risk.why: Deletions are limited to unused code and compiler warning flag activations; errors would primarily cause build failures rather than runtime faults.

scope_notes: The PR consists of 18 small commits spanning 23 files across multiple subsystems, and currently includes a commit tagged `[[nomerge]] crc32c changes`.
summary: Removes unused functions, methods, constants, and template instantiations across multiple subsystems, including Qt, script, kernel, netbase, policy, and logging. It also turns on the `-Wunused-macros` and `-Wunused-template` compiler warnings in the build system.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided in the prompt, so exact changes cannot be verified beyond commit messages.
The commit tagged `[[nomerge]] crc32c changes` indicates in-progress or testing work.
